source_of_truth: voicebridge/office/tower.py (state/hud/floorplan), verified by calling tower.state() against a live populated store

licence_note.aphae: rsanandres/aphae ships NO licence file (all rights reserved). Read for design only. No aphae code was copied, adapted, transliterated or pasted; aphae influence is limited to the design ideas marked aphae_derived. No code from aphae appears in this file or in the doc.
licence_note.mit_references: pixel-agents (MIT) OfficeCanvas.tsx / ToolOverlay.tsx were read for technique that may be ported; they inform existing camera and overlay work, not new panels.

nullable_fields.when_null: seat has no event on record
nullable_fields.renderer_rule: meters/last-event lines render grey and empty; never a made-up value

nullable_fields.when_null: absent unless the character is mid-walk (0<t<1)
nullable_fields.renderer_rule: no progress => no progress bar; never default to 0 or 1
render in the not-at-a-desk strip; never fabricate a floor
render 'unknown' with hint 'nothing is burning yet'; never 0 and never Infinity

panels.name: Floor stack board
panels.shows: one row per floor: number, role, department count, revenue/cost/net; net cell coloured by sign
panels.edge_cases: departments==0 renders as 'empty floor', still shown

panels.name: Floor focus bar
panels.shows: all / F<n> buttons; selecting one re-frames the camera and filters the minimap
panels.renderer_computes: aria-pressed from local floor state; re-frame key = number + ':' + rooms.length
panels.edge_cases: no floors -> only the 'all' button renders

panels.name: Stat strip
panels.shows: Headcount, Revenue, Cost, Net, Burn/day, Runway
panels.renderer_computes: money() for whole cents, moneyRate() for the sub-cent rate

panels.name: Agent needs meters
panels.shows: three labelled bars for the selected character: Freshness, Progress, Attention

meters.label: Freshness
meters.null_rule: last_event null -> grey, empty bar; never a made-up value

meters.label: Progress
meters.null_rule: field is NOT in the payload today (see N11) -> render no bar at all; when the field lands, read it verbatim and never animate client-side

meters.label: Attention
meters.formula: full red bar if stalled, else flat ok bar
meters.null_rule: stalled is authoritative; never re-derived from age_s client-side

panels.renderer_computes: the freshness subtraction and the clamp; bar geometry
panels.forbidden: no client-side decay, no timer, no CSS animation — every bar value comes from the payload each poll (C7)
panels.aphae_idea: aphae's inspector draws a labelled bar per need; adopted as bars over fields we actually carry, minus the client-side decay aphae uses for its own game clock.

panels.name: Selected-agent inspector
panels.shows: name(slug), role, dept, state, location, stalled line, last event
panels.renderer_computes: string assembly; the '(walking)' suffix from walking
panels.edge_cases: department_id null -> role alone; position.floor null -> not-at-a-desk strip

panels.name: Character name labels over agents
panels.shows: a short label over/near each figure on the canvas
panels.renderer_computes: label placement, status-band colour from the animation map, grey fallback for unknown animation
panels.limitation: label text MUST be slug; tower sends no display name (see N1)
panels.aphae_idea: aphae prints a title above each figure so the crowd is legible without clicking.

panels.name: Activity feed
panels.shows: event stream newest first, each row '[HH:MM:SS] text'
panels.edge_cases: empty array -> the empty sentence, never a fabricated row
panels.aphae_idea: aphae's log prefixes every entry with a day/time stamp. Adopted the timestamp prefix; the tab split needs a backend field (N7).

panels.name: Building / minimap
panels.shows: floors and rooms as rects, characters as markers
panels.renderer_computes: scale to canvas; stalled marker red; unknown animation grey

panels.name: P&L by day
panels.shows: green revenue bars, red cost bars, blue net line, one column per day
panels.renderer_computes: chart scale from max(revenue,cost,net) and min(net); bar/line geometry
panels.edge_cases: zero days are kept in history and must be drawn, not skipped

panels.name: Preview banner
panels.edge_cases: preview is only ever true for an EMPTY org with ?preview=1

panels.name: Honesty / motion strip
panels.shows: motion_rule, count of moving characters, count of stalled, read-only pill
panels.renderer_computes: membership count in the motion set {working,walking,carrying,glow,settling,meeting,walking_to_manager}
panels.forbidden: must not count blocked/done/stopped/paused as work

panels.name: Character roster
panels.shows: clickable list of seats; selection populates P5 and P4
panels.renderer_computes: sort by agent_id (store ORDER BY id), stable across polls

control_bar.location: top of the page, one row (existing styles.bar)
control_bar.rule: every button is a pure view operation; no request is issued by any of them, so C4 holds by construction

buttons.label: Fit
buttons.changes: fitToBuilding over the floors currently shown

buttons.label: Zoom - / +
buttons.note: CHAR_FLOOR_ZOOM keeps characters legible; an office whose people are invisible is not a drawing of an office

cannot_support.reason: commits state; a mutation, only allowed through dashboard_ops -> 409+confirmation_id -> confirm path
every edit writes office_room/office_agent; violates C4
destructive write; must run through the confirmation journal
write; even the dashboard treats these as STAGED ops, i.e. not this plugin

cannot_support.feature: Approve / deny a staged review or escalation
cannot_support.reason: settles a confirmation_id; a write on the confirmation path
no client-side clock exists; a real org pause is a server-side write (C4) and would violate C7 if faked in the client

backend_gaps.wanted: Character display name (e.g. 'Alice') over figures and in the inspector
backend_gaps.needs: a name on the character/seat object; only slug and seat_type exist today

backend_gaps.wanted: Per-character memory / relationship / goal lines (aphae's richest panel content)
backend_gaps.needs: any per-agent memory, relationship or goal data in the payload
metered spend attributed to the seat; may not be derivable (README notes provider spend is cap-attested, not measured)

backend_gaps.wanted: Org model tier per seat (D3 best/cheap)
backend_gaps.needs: a tier field on the character or hud
supervisor_id is a number; a resolvable label/name is absent
backend_gaps.status: partially present; label needs a backend field

backend_gaps.wanted: Activity tab split (run lifecycle vs capability/tool events)
backend_gaps.needs: a category on activity[] or a server-side filter param; kind exists and could drive client-side grouping, which is a possible design not a payload field
a counter in hud; derivable from characters[].animation by the renderer, so no field required
backend_gaps.status: derivable; no field required (avoid a redundant hud field)

backend_gaps.needs: a capex total in hud; the ledger has capex rows but the payload exposes only the folds listed
no new data: walk_for() already computes progress (verified 0.25 mid-walk) but state() copies only walk.x/walk.y into position and drops progress
backend_gaps.status: needs a backend fix, not a new field — carry progress through state(); until then the P4 progress meter renders nothing
